subject.title: fix(text): strip MiniMax marker from channel replies

question: Should this PR wait for after-fix official MiniMax channel proof, or should a maintainer explicitly override that proof gate based on the stream tests and existing before-fix screenshot?
rationale: The code path is plausible and well tested, but the external-PR gate requires observed after-fix behavior from the affected official provider, and the protected human-review state leaves that sufficiency choice to a maintainer.

options.title: Require official-provider proof
options.body: Capture a redacted official MiniMax Telegram or live-stream run showing the terminal marker removed while literal marker-like text remains intact.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the focused stream tests and before-fix screenshot as sufficient for this provider-specific bug.

recommendation.title: Require official-provider proof
recommendation.body: Capture a redacted official MiniMax Telegram or live-stream run showing the terminal marker removed while literal marker-like text remains intact.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active review context and performed the live provider-boundary comparison that shaped the current implementation.
